title: connectToggle doesn't work
body: **Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?** **Bug: What is the current behavior?** Current toggle always passes the value to algolia as undefined: When clicking a toggle, it adds this to the search state: `?toggle%5Bremote%5D=true`. Inspecting the algolia request sends remote: undefined: Even using refine(true) in component did mount will do the exact same thing, it updates the search state, but passes undefined. **Bug: What is the expected behavior?** For the toggle to send the value I pass in createURL / refine to actually be used. **What project are you opening an issue for?** - react-instantsearch 3.2 **What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.** 3.2
